title: Form field
description: A first-class versioned content citizen for one official form location (ADR-0012). It declares what the printed field means and how a current derivation disposition is presented; it is never a fact, finding, rule, or authoritative store of a rendered value. `binds_symbol` is one-way presentation content: the rule publishes a symbol without knowing which fields render it, and the field references the symbol it presents without owning the derived finding. `citation_ref` is an inert reference under ADR-0012; a future resolver decision governs its semantics. Published versions are immutable (Article 9, ADR-0003); a new form year, locator, meaning, binding, or rendering contract is a new citizen/version, never an edit.

dispositions.description: Declared rendering and explanation instructions for the five ADR-0012 disposition classes. A renderer selects an instruction from the actual current output/run disposition; it never invents state — no inferring closure from an empty collection, turning a block into zero, or rendering a false guard as a computed blank. Machine records may refine `blocked` into schema'd codes; the field carries one blocked instruction and the explanation surface preserves the refinement.

instruction.description: `render` is the literal placed in the cell for the disposition: the token {value} substitutes the published amount, and the empty string means an intentionally blank cell. `explain` states the lineage the explanation surface must preserve — computed_zero and closure_backed_zero may share a glyph but never an explanation (ADR-0012 decision 6).
